  2. Round 76the watchdog race was real, and turning Tunk off did not turn it offscored

    ■fail

    2026-08-16 13:08 UTC

    A probe driving the real code counted 16 @Published writes and 16 NSEvent monitor calls off the main thread, and ThreadSanitizer confirmed the race in Engine.watchdog(). Fixed by splitting on hazard: main keeps the published state and the AppKit monitors, a serial queue takes only the call that can hang. TSan clean across three 20-cycle runs.

    biggest gapThe verifying critic then found worse, by code read and then measured: stopSensors() returns as soon as the close is enqueued and feed(sample:) had no armed check, so 4069 samples reached the detector after the user turned detection off during a wedge - with the keystroke gate already removed and the action runner still reachable. Fixed with one guard. The detector is byte-identical throughout.

  3. Round 75the app subsystem was audited, and the acceptance test was brokenscored

    ■fail

    2026-08-16 11:50 UTC

    TunkApp had never had a dedicated critic. It found that --acceptance never ran an event loop, so NSEvent monitors delivered nothing and the keystroke gate was absent for the entire test - phase 2 was measuring typing false triggers with no gate, the regime this corpus prices at 188 per 20 min against a shipped 0.

    biggest gapAlso demonstrated: any ordinary config write stripped the resonator's derived threshold while leaving its front end running - 0.011 to 0.032 after one slider drag, healing on relaunch, the classic irreproducible report. Both fixed. Still open and argued: the watchdog mutates @Published state and AppKit monitors off the main thread, and calibration can wedge if onDisappear does not fire for the sheet.

  16. Round 62a band I proposed myself, and it was a fitscored

    The premise was false: a band filters CANDIDATES, not rescues, so rejecting the winning crest promotes the next one from the buffer and the rescue survives. rectMin 0.50 leaves all 19 rescues intact. The residue is a 0.015-wide window whose train optimum sits exactly where held-out has already lost a gesture.

    biggest gapHeld-out cannot grade false triggers at all. Held-out lap is 1.5 minutes with zero typing and zero confound sessions; train lap runs 6.5 false triggers per 20 min, so over 1.5 minutes the expected count is 0.5. '0 held-out lap false triggers' is consistent with exactly the train rate - not evidence of zero, evidence of insufficient exposure. Every false-trigger claim against that split inherits the limit.
